description: This module manipulates files privileges using the Linux capabilities(7) system.

parameters.name: capability
parameters.description: Desired capability to set (with operator and flags, if state=present) or remove (if state=absent).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Specifies the path to the file to be managed.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the entry should be present or absent in the file’s capabilities. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

examples:
- name: Set cap_sys_chroot+ep on /foo
  community.general.capabilities:
    path: /foo
    capability: cap_sys_chroot+ep
    state: present

- name: Remove cap_net_bind_service from /bar
  community.general.capabilities:
    path: /bar
    capability: cap_net_bind_service
    state: absent
